## Pixcall AI Tagger 2.2.2

### New Model

- Adds Llama JoyCaption Beta One 8B support through the local llamafile backend.
- The built-in downloader provides the fast, recommended Q4_K_M GGUF main model and its required F16 vision projection model.

### Installation

Download `pixcall-plugin-v2.2.2.zip`, extract it, and load the included `release-dist` folder from Pixcall's plugin manager.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bukkumaaku/pixcall-tagger/compare/v2.2.1...v2.2.2
